gumtree_entries.description: UPDATED o1 -> i1: This file was automatically generated by EvoSuite Mon Jun 15 23:12:53 GMT 2026
ADDED i3: Directly setting tagName bypasses normalName update, so clone with proper name() call ends up with different normalName → not equal.
ADDED i4: updates both tagName and normalName
ADDED i5: Two-arg constructor uses second arg as namespace; one-arg defaults to HTML namespace.
ADDED i7: Directly reassigning the static RcData constant to 512 so that options=512 triggers the RcData branch inside textState().
ADDED i8: Tag.Data = 256 (1<<8); setting options to 256 triggers the Data branch.
ADDED i14: SeenSelfClose tracks that a self-close was observed in the source; it does NOT grant self-closing capability.
ADDED i19: clear() sets the Known flag for any option except Known itself.
ADDED i20: Clearing option == Tag.Known (1) is the only case where Known is NOT re-set.
